result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: CGL at USD 1M per occurrence/2M aggregate, E&O at USD 2M, conditional cyber coverage at USD 5M, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates on request. Unrelated provisions remain substantively unchanged. However, requiring all coverage to continue for one year after expiration or termination exceeds the supplied playbook and is not necessary to reach its position; it is also awkward as applied to occurrence-based CGL and workers’ compensation. Otherwise, the clause is professionally drafted.
